title: Animals Around Us
description: Grade 2 Science: animals around us — wild and tame animals, animals that help us, animal sounds and homes, and how to care for animals. Interactive games included.

topics.title: Wild and Tame Animals
topics.concept:
We can sort animals into two big groups by where they live:

  • 🦁 Wild animals live in forests, deserts or jungles and find their own food. Lion, tiger, elephant and deer are wild.
  • 🐄 Tame (domestic) animals live with people, who feed and care for them. Cow, dog, cat and hen are tame.

recap: Wild animals live on their own in forests and jungles.
Tame (domestic) animals live with people who care for them.
Lion = wild; cow and dog = tame.

wonder.text: A lion and a cow are both animals. Why can we keep one at home but not the other?

qa.a: Some wild animals can be dangerous because they are not used to people. That is why we watch them safely from far away, like at a zoo or wildlife park.

qa.q: Can a wild animal become tame?
qa.a: Long, long ago, people slowly tamed some wild animals like dogs and cows over many years. But we should never try to tame a wild animal ourselves.

topics.title: Animals That Help Us
topics.concept:
Many tame animals are great helpers. They give us food and do important work:

  • 🐄 Cow and 🐃 buffalo give us milk.
  • 🐔 Hen gives us eggs.
  • 🐑 Sheep gives us wool for warm clothes.
  • 🐝 Bees give us honey.
  • 🐕 Dog guards our home; 🐎 horse and 🐂 ox help carry and pull loads.

recap: Cow and buffalo give milk; hen gives eggs.
Sheep gives wool; bees give honey.
Dogs guard us; horses and oxen help carry loads.

wonder.text: Milk, eggs, wool, and even a friendly guard — animals give us so much. Can you name one gift?

qa.q: How do we get wool without hurting the sheep?
qa.a: A sheep's woolly coat is cut off gently, just like a haircut. It does not hurt, and the wool grows back — then we make sweaters from it!

qa.q: Why is a dog called our best friend?
qa.a: Dogs are loyal and loving. They guard our homes, help find lost people, and are wonderful, caring companions to us.

topics.title: Animal Sounds
topics.concept:
Animals make sounds to talk to each other — to call their family, warn of danger or find a friend. Each animal has its own special sound:

  • 🐄 Cow → moo
  • 🐕 Dog → bark
  • 🐈 Cat → meow
  • 🦁 Lion → roar
  • 🐔 Hen → cluck, Rooster → cock-a-doodle-doo
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#fff7ea"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🐄</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Moo</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🐕</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Woof</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🐈</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Meow</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Animal sounds</text></svg>
recap: Animals make sounds to talk to each other.
Cow → moo, dog → bark, cat → meow, lion → roar.
Sounds can call family or warn of danger.

wonder.text: A cow says 'moo' and a cat says 'meow'. Why do animals make different sounds?

qa.a: A dog barks to talk! It may be saying hello, warning that a stranger is near, or asking to play. Barking is a dog's way of speaking.

qa.q: Do animals understand each other's sounds?
qa.a: Animals of the same kind understand their own sounds very well. A mother hen's cluck calls her chicks, and they come running to her!

topics.title: Where Animals Live
topics.concept:
The place where an animal lives is called its home or habitat. Animals live where they can find food and stay safe:

  • 🐟 Fish live in water.
  • 🐪 Camels live in the desert.
  • 🐒 Monkeys live in forests, in trees.
  • 🐻‍❄️ Polar bears live in very cold, snowy lands.
  • 🐄 Farm animals live near people.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#eef6ff"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🐟</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Water</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🐪</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Desert</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🐒</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Forest</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Where animals live</text></svg>
recap: An animal's home is the place where it lives (its habitat).
Fish → water, camel → desert, monkey → forest.
Animals live where they find food and stay safe.

wonder.text: A fish needs water and a camel loves the desert. Why does each animal have its own special home?

qa.q: How does a camel live in the hot desert?
qa.a: A camel stores food in its hump and can go many days without water. Its body is perfect for the dry, hot desert — its special home.

qa.q: Why can't a fish live on land?
qa.a: A fish breathes the air mixed in water using its gills. On dry land it cannot breathe, so water is the only home where a fish can live.

topics.title: Caring for Animals
topics.concept:
All animals can feel happy, hungry and hurt — so we must be kind and care for them:

  • 🍲 Give pets clean food and fresh water.
  • 🏠 Give them a safe, clean place to rest.
  • ❤️ Be gentle — never hit or frighten an animal.
  • 🩺 Take sick animals to an animal doctor (a vet).

Even street animals deserve our kindness. A little water on a hot day can help so much.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#fff0f0"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🍲</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Feed</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">💧</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Water</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🩺</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Vet</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Caring for animals</text></svg>
recap: Give pets food, water and a clean, safe home.
Be gentle — never hurt or scare an animal.
A vet is an animal doctor who helps sick animals.

wonder.text: Animals give us so much. How can we be kind to them?

qa.a: A vet is a special doctor for animals. When a pet is sick or hurt, the vet checks it and gives medicine to help it feel better.

qa.q: How can I help street animals?
qa.a: On a hot day you can keep a bowl of clean water outside (with a grown-up). Being gentle and never throwing things at them is a big kindness.

questions.explanation: A cow lives with people who feed and care for it — it is tame.
Sheep give us wool for warm clothes.
A dog barks to talk to us.
A camel is built for the dry, hot desert.

questions.q: The kind way to treat animals is to…
options: Be gentle and care for them
questions.explanation: We should be gentle and give animals food, water and care.

questions.q: Why can't a fish live on land?
options: It breathes water with gills, not air
questions.explanation: A fish uses gills to breathe the air mixed in water, so it cannot breathe on land.

questions.q: How does a camel survive the desert without water for days?
options: It stores food in its hump
questions.explanation: A camel stores food in its hump and can go a long time without water.

questions.q: Which set lists only WILD animals?
questions.explanation: Lion, tiger and deer all live in the wild.

options: To talk — call family or warn of danger
questions.explanation: Animals make sounds to communicate — to call their family or warn of danger.

options: Is like a haircut and does not hurt
questions.explanation: Wool is cut gently like a haircut; it does not hurt and grows back.
